title: Sunday Daily Practice
subtitle: Review Lessons 6 and 7, then write 50 words about a person
source: Foundation 11 lesson plan, week 4 (B6 Time and routines, B7 Other people's habits), Sun 8 Nov
intro: Four steps, about 45 minutes. Deadline: 23:00 the same day. Step 3 is a writing task: type it in the box on the website. Step 4 is a voice note.

steps.title: Step 1 · Review: Lesson 6 and 7 words
steps.instructions: Fill in each gap with one word from Lessons 6 and 7.

items.label: I want to ____ fit by swimming. (keep)

items.q: I wake up ____ six on weekdays.

steps.title: Step 3 · Writing: one person's habits (about 50 words)
steps.instructions: Write about 50 words about one person you know. Use he or she, at least three verbs with -s or -es, one doesn't, and one Lesson 7 word. Type it in the box on the website.

open.model: My sister Lan is a busy student. She wakes up at six and makes breakfast for us. She goes to school by bike. In the evening she studies English and watches a short video. On Sunday she does the laundry. She doesn't like noise, so she reads in her room.

ai.type: Short paragraph about one person's habits
ai.task: Write about 50 words about one person you know. Use he or she, at least three verbs with -s or -es, one doesn't, and one Lesson 7 word.
criteria: he or she with a verb ending in -s or -es
capital letter at the start of each sentence and a full stop at the end

steps.title: Step 4 · Voice note: read your paragraph
steps.instructions: Read your paragraph from step 3 aloud, slowly, then record one voice note.
lines: Read your paragraph aloud, slowly. Hold the -s and -es endings, and the final sound of watches and washes.

send_today: Four steps. Writing in step 3 and voice note in step 4 are sent to the teacher when you press Submit.
